output.question: Where can I find General Motors' latest 10-K filing?
output.answer: General Motors' latest 10-K is available on the SEC's EDGAR system. It was filed on January 27, 2026, covers the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, and can be opened directly here: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785826000013/gm-20251231.htm. The SEC filing index is here: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1467858/000146785826000013/0001467858-26-000013-index.htm.

key_facts.fact: General Motors Co.'s most recent Form 10-K was filed on January 27, 2026.
The filing is General Motors' Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
